title: Console: Animated Status Indicators & Localized Color Tokens — keyboard nav & WCAG fixes
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Background: Several console widgets (route status chips, rollout badges, cost sync indicators) use small animated indicators and thin colored strokes to surface state. During recent WCAG audits and localization QA we found three issues: 1) low contrast ratios for some animated states when placed on dark panels (fails AA for 14px body text equivalents), 2) animated motion is not respecting prefers-reduced-motion and can interfere with screen reader timing/announcements, and 3) localized layouts (RTL and CJK numerals) cause indicator offsets and inconsistent hit targets. Goal: Replace fragile color choices and animation patterns with accessible tokens and motion rules while keeping visual clarity and brand cues across locales.
acceptance_criteria: All status chips and small indicators meet WCAG AA contrast thresholds for text/iconography (4.5:1 for 'text-equivalent' labels and 3:1 for graphical elements) across light/dark themes
Animated indicators honor prefers-reduced-motion and provide a non-animated equivalent state that preserves status semantics
Keyboard focus order reaches indicators reliably; focus ring is visible and localized (no overlap with adjacent RTL content)
Screen readers announce status changes within 400ms of the state transition and announcement copy matches tokenized localized strings
Color tokens updated with colorblind-safe palette and provided as semantic variables (e.g., --status-success, --status-warning, --status-pending) with tints for 16px and 12px variants
Figma prototype approved and demo passes manual QA on at least two localized builds (en-US and ar-SA) and Chrome + VoiceOver on macOS
prototype_notes: Prototype includes toggles for prefers-reduced-motion, theme switch, and RTL mirroring
Small-pulse animation duration standardized to 800ms with transform-only transitions to avoid layout jank
Non-animated fallback uses subtle opacity/scale change + distinct outline for state emphasis
implementation_guidance: Use semantic color tokens; do not hardcode hex values in components
CSS: prefer transform/opacity animations and include @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to disable keyframes
Provide aria-live="polite" for transient updates and aria-label attributes tied to localization strings
Ensure 12px badge variants use a stronger tint or thin outline to meet 3:1 contrast
Account for numeral widths in RTL by testing badge padding at max digit width for locales like ar-SA and fa-IR
qa_steps: 1) Load Figma prototype and toggle prefers-reduced-motion: verify animations stop and static indicator retains status color and outline
2) Run Lighthouse accessibility audit on demo page in light/dark themes and confirm no contrast failures for indicator labels
3) Navigate to rollout table using keyboard only: tab to the row, press Tab to reach status chip, confirm focus ring is visible and keyboard activation opens detail panel
4) Switch OS to Arabic (RTL) locale and confirm badge alignment, numbering and focus order remain correct
5) Use VoiceOver/ChromeVox to capture announcement text when status changes and verify it matches localized copy (sample string keys included below)
6) Cross-browser check: Chrome, Safari, and Firefox on macOS and Windows; capture screenshots of failing permutations
review_comments: PM (Jordan Patel): Can we get a small benchmark of how color swaps affect existing dashboards? Need to ensure no unexpected visual regressions in customer fleets.
Engineering (Lena Morales): Prefer tokens with both 12px/16px variants; will implement as --status-warning-12 and --status-warning-16. Also request motion timing variables for runtime toggles.
Accessibility (Dr. Omar Aziz): Reduce pulsing luminance and ensure pulse uses only opacity/scale; provide test case with a simulated low-vision filter.
Design review (Marta Kovacs): Adjusted success hue by +4 degrees to improve deutan coverage; updated Figma color styles and documented contrast ratios per variant.
decisions: Adopt semantic tokens and publish a migration guide for existing components
Default animation will be enabled; prefer-reduced-motion will switch to 0 duration + static emphasis ring
Use aria-live="polite" and explicit aria-label values rather than relying on visual text for SR announces
follow_ups: DES-46212: Create storybook stories for each indicator state and locale variants
ENG-8214: Implement tokens and theme mapping in component library
PM-391: Add automated contrast checks in CI for PRs touching status tokens
